description: Na₄Zn₃Se₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.83-2.94 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five Se atoms to form NaSe₅ square pyramids that share corners with three equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with four ZnSe₄ tetrahedra, edges with four equivalent NaSe₅ square pyramids, and edges with four ZnSe₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-54°. There are three shorter (3.08 Å) and two longer (3.13 Å) Na-Se bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaSe₅ square pyramids, corners with five ZnSe₄ tetrahedra, edges with four equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with five ZnSe₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.99-3.25 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.07 Å. There are three inequivalent Zn sites. In the first Zn site, Zn is bonded to four Se atoms to form ZnSe₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaSe₅ square pyramids, corners with six ZnSe₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaSe₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 15°. There are two shorter (2.52 Å) and two longer (2.53 Å) Zn-Se bond lengths. In the second Zn site, Zn is bonded to four Se atoms to form distorted ZnSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaSe₅ square pyramids, corners with six ZnSe₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaSe₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 48°. There are a spread of Zn-Se bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.61 Å. In the third Zn site, Zn is bonded to four Se atoms to form distorted ZnSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with six ZnSe₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 18°. There are a spread of Zn-Se bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.60 Å. There are five inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Zn atoms. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na and two equivalent Zn atoms. In the third Se site, Se is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six Na and two Zn atoms. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded to three equivalent Na and three Zn atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SeNa₃Zn₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 73°. In the fifth Se site, Se is bonded to three Na and three Zn atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SeNa₃Zn₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 73°.
